answer_1.quote: We utilize the OpenAI API (version o1-preview) for this process. In our prompt, we instruct the model to generate a more contextually enriched version of the original sentence containing the target event, using the full article as as input.

answer_2.quote: Model performance is compared across RECB, GVC, and ECB+ under a cross-evaluation setting.

answer_4.quote: We hire 4 researchers and graduate students from the linguistics and computer science departments of a US-based university for the annotation work.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are tasked with classifying ranked event pairs with decontextualized sentences into one of the predefined event relations...
